name: Image Correction
posted_by: Private individual — handle 'Archivist' — vouched through a single B-tier broker chain
target: Sable Chun — blackmailer, synthetic-identity fabricator, operating out of the Norden Residential Blocks in the mid-stack transit district
objective: Kill Chun and physically recover or destroy the fabrication hardware and any stored recordings in her possession.
location: Norden Residential Blocks, mid-stack transit district, specific unit known to broker — 14th floor walk-up, building 7
payout: Φ90,000 (Φ60k on confirmation of death, Φ30k on hardware delivery)
deadline: Open, but posting entity flagged urgency
complications: Norden Residential is dense, vertical, and Tier 2 — neighbors notice and talk; a body in a walk-up building will be found quickly and traced back through building access logs

Chun's hardware is described as 'portable fabrication architecture' which could mean anything from a suitcase rig to distributed components hidden across multiple locations — the recovery clause may be uncompletable
The posting entity 'Archivist' has only a single vouching chain, which is thin for someone posting at Φ90k — either they're new to this or they deliberately kept their broker exposure minimal
description:
Sable Chun is a blackmailer running synthetic-identity recordings — fabricated audio and visual composites of real people doing or saying things they didn't do or say. The posting describes a victim who has lost their employment, their housing placement, and their custody arrangement over a recording that Chun created from harvested biometric data. The 'Archivist' handle is the victim, or someone acting on their behalf. The urgency flag suggests Chun is either escalating her demands or has threatened wider distribution.

This one is largely what it says it is. Chun is real, the fabrication operation is real, and the harm being described has been done to at least one verifiable person — the broker who vouched the chain confirmed the custody case as documented. The complication is that Chun almost certainly has multiple clients' worth of fabricated material and multiple victims' worth of leverage, which means killing her will stop the ongoing blackmail but may not prevent cached recordings from reaching distribution channels through a dead-man automation she's set up. The freelancer is being hired to do something straightforwardly justified, but the outcome they're being paid to deliver may not actually produce the relief the posting entity is hoping for.
story_hooks: Among the hardware recovered, the freelancer finds fabricated recordings involving people other than the posting entity's victim — some of those people are dead, some are mid-tier corporate figures, and one appears to be an active ACS officer currently stationed in the district

The dead-man automation Chun set up triggers partially when she dies — some recordings begin moving toward distribution targets, and the freelancer has a narrow window to decide whether to try to intercept them or walk away with their Φ90k
